newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Canberra names preferred buyer for Works Australia.
newsitem.headline: Canberra names preferred buyer for Works Australia.

text.p: The Australian government on Friday named Gutteridge Haskins and Davey Pty Ltd as the preferred buyer for project management, architectural and engineering service provider Works Australia.

The company is one of six to be sold as part of an Administrative Services Department privatisation plan announced in the August 1996 budget, Finance Minister John Fahey and Administrative Services Minister David Jull said in a joint statement.
The proceeds from the sale would be announced when the contracts were exchanged in a few weeks, Fahey and Jull said.
The government expected to announce the preferred bidders for the other Administrative Services Department business units shortly.
Gutteridge Haskins and Davey is a wholly-owned Australian company of consulting engineers, environmental scientists and planners and project managers.
